fullTitle: FDA approval of tirzepatide for moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity
citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. FDA approves first medication for obstructive sleep apnea. December 20, 2024.
currencyNote: FDA approved tirzepatide (Zepbound) on 2024-12-20 for moderate-to-severe OSA in adults with obesity, in combination with reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity. This is a treatment-selection/prescribing issue for qualified clinicians, not an independent technologist protocol.
bestFor: Current awareness that pharmacologic weight-management therapy has an FDA-approved OSA indication in a defined adult obesity population, and for understanding why older alternative-therapy lists are incomplete.

mappingRationale.D4B: Adds current non-PAP pharmacotherapy awareness to the weight-management pathway while preserving prescribing/scope boundaries.

authorityBoundary: FDA drug labeling governs the approved indication and safety labeling; this record is not an AASM clinical practice guideline and is not an independent prescribing protocol. Medication selection, dosing, contraindication review, monitoring, and continuation decisions belong to the treating clinician. Current AASM obesity-management resources may support education but do not change technologist scope.
